$comment: Local extension: upstream SAP abap-file-formats has no UCON HTTP service format. Field names map to UCONHTTPSERVTEXT (short text), UCONHTTPSERVHANDL (ordered handler classes) and the optional ICF node link (ICFNAME/ICFPARGUID); the ICF /ucon_http/<name> wire document mirrors this shape.
title: UCON HTTP Service Properties
description: UCON HTTP service (UCON_HTTP): ordered ICF handler classes exposed through Unified Connectivity

description.title: Description
description.description: Short text of the HTTP service (UCONHTTPSERVTEXT-SHORTTEXT, CHAR 255, single line). Language-dependent: the CLI reads and writes the session language.

handlers.title: Handlers
handlers.description: Handler classes in service order (UCONHTTPSERVHANDL-SERVICEORDER / SERVICEHANDLER). At least one class is required; classes must exist in the target system.

order.title: Service Order
order.description: 2-digit service order (UCONHTTPSERVHANDL-SERVICEORDER). Optional: the list position is used when omitted.

handlerClass.title: Handler Class
handlerClass.description: Global ABAP class that handles the service (UCONHTTPSERVHANDL-SERVICEHANDLER, CHAR 30). Must exist in the target system.

icfService.title: ICF Service Link
icfService.description: Optional link to an existing SICF node (ICFNAME / ICFPARGUID). Older releases require the link; omit it for a standalone service. A pull fills it when the service carries a link.
